responsibility: This C source file provides the tiny C-side runtime support object linked into gm2-libs-min programs. It defines dummy abort and exit functions as non-returning infinite loops, giving embedded or freestanding GNU Modula-2 links concrete libc-style termination symbols without depending on a full host C library implementation.
same_name_distinction: Unlike libc.def, which is the Modula-2 foreign declaration layer, this same-stem file is the C implementation object that actually defines the tiny runtime symbols abort and exit as infinite-loop stubs for freestanding linking.
